Book Appointment (602)296-0021 1000+ Patients Trust us with their smiles Phoenix Dentist for Long-Term Oral Health At Advanced Smiles Center, we believe great dentistry starts with prevention and personalized care. Your oral health plays a vital role in your overall well-being, which is why we focus on early detection, patient education, and long-term treatment planning. ​ From routine cleanings to advanced dental procedures, our team at Advanced Smiles Center provides comprehensive care designed to protect your smile today and for years to come. We take the time to understand your needs, explain your options, and create treatment plans that fit your goals and lifestyle. ​ Whether you’re visiting us for preventive care, cosmetic improvements, or restorative treatment, you can expect a comfortable experience, modern technology, and a team that puts your health first. Book Appointment Comprehensive Dental Care From preventive care to advanced treatments, Advanced Smiles Center offers a full range of dental services to keep your smile healthy and beautiful. Family Dentistry Cosmetic Dentistry Laser Dentistry Gum Disease Tooth Extractions Endodontics Dentures Partial Dentures Clear Aligners Insurance, Pricing & Membership Options Advanced Smiles Center believes quality dental care should be clear, affordable, and easy to understand. Our team works with many major insurance providers and explains costs upfront, so there are no surprises.   For patients without insurance, our in-office membership plans offer predictable pricing and valuable savings—making dental care simple, flexible, and stress-free. Explore Our Membership Plan Why Our Patients Trust Advanced Smiler Center.   Phoenix patients choose us for dentistry that’s efficient, comfortable, and centered on long-term health.   Scheduling / Convenience Transparent Pricing Technology Comfort / Trust Easy Online Scheduling Your time matters — that’s why Advanced Smiles Center offers simple online scheduling for all patients.   In just a few clicks, you can book a dental cleaning, exam, or follow-up appointment at a time that works best for you.   Manage your appointments online and stay connected with your dental team with less hassle and more convenience. Transparent Pricing & Insurance Help We make quality dental care accessible and affordable.   Our office works with most major dental insurance providers and offers flexible payment options to fit your needs.   For patients without insurance, we also provide clear pricing and in-office solutions, so you always know what to expect before your visit begins. Technology-Driven Dental Care From digital X-rays to advanced imaging and modern treatment tools, we use today’s dental technology to deliver precise, efficient care.   These tools allow us to diagnose concerns earlier, plan treatments more accurately, and provide a more comfortable experience at every visit. No Judgment. Just Care. We get it — life happens, and sometimes dental visits get delayed.   Whether you’re overdue, feeling anxious, or returning after a long break, our team is here to help you move forward with confidence.   Our focus is on your comfort, your health, and what’s next for your smile. Limited-Time Dental Specials Take advantage of Advanced Smiles Center’s exclusive patient offers designed to make high-quality dental care more affordable and accessible. View Specials Because Your Smile Matters. Here’s why patients continue to choose Advanced Smiles Center in Phoenix for affordable dental care and reliable, professional results—visit after visit.   Ricky Golden Waller "I'm 72 and have been to a few dental surgeons across the country. Westwind Dental's staff is very hospitable, professional and informative. They have a dental surgeon named Dhillon just wow." Tammy Rangel "From start to finish was fabulous. I mean I had my emergency situation which was painful to start & Stephanie in the front got me in right away & was super fun & sweet." Brenda Acero "The Surgeon was fantastic! He did such great and amazing job! It was quick & painless. Norma explained everything to me. The Dr answered all of my questions." Ready to Take the Next Step? Your smile deserves thoughtful, professional care.   Whether you’re scheduling a routine visit or need help with a specific concern, our team is here to make the process easy and comfortable from start to finish.
